answers.goal: I want to do what Rachel Sennott, Quinta Brunson, and Issa Rae are doing.  A mix of writing, performing, and maybe directing.  However, I am incredibly open to wherever the wind takes me.
answers.drew: I’m a former college athlete.  After I suffered 3 significant injuries in a row, I decided to take some film classes at my local junior college while I recovered.  It was there that I found out the similarities between sports and film.  People working together towards a common goal to create something meaningful.  The better the teamwork and community, the better the product.  I think this industry is so important in understanding other perspectives, while also giving people all over the world something to enjoy and talk about with one another.  Who wouldn’t want to be a part of that?
answers.seeking: I’m a people person and genuinely love talking with anyone about anything.  I enjoy hearing what people are passionate about and finding common ground between us.  I’m looking for people who want to get to know me and others.  People who strive for more knowledge.  People who want to understand other people and are unapologetically themselves.  I’m looking for people who are willing to work hard to achieve their goals.  I’d love to meet people who want to be producers and agents as well.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is currently Greta Gerwig.  The way she’s able to create stories while keeping and positive set environment is something I hope to emulate in the future.
